variants.headline: Our verdict: a failure of responsibility
variants.body: There is not enough food in {colony}. People are hungry, and the political debate must answer that simple, urgent fact. We hold {target} responsible.

variants.headline: Principles demand an answer for hunger
variants.body: Food is insufficient and people are hungry in {colony}. Political principles should be judged by what they mean for those people. We hold {target} responsible.

variants.headline: No trust without enough to eat
variants.body: People are going hungry in {colony} because food is insufficient. Any political argument should keep their needs at its centre. We hold {target} responsible.
